scripts.build:docker: docker build -t reliefinventory:dev --build-arg RI_GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --build-arg RI_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) .
scripts.build:docker:multiarch: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -t reliefinventory:dev --build-arg RI_GIT_COMMIT=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD) --build-arg RI_BUILD_DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ) .
scripts.build:print-client: npm --prefix print-client install && npm --prefix print-client run tauri build
scripts.build:launcher: npm --prefix launcher install && npm --prefix launcher run tauri build
scripts.dev:launcher: npm --prefix launcher install && npm --prefix launcher run tauri dev
scripts.build:rstation: npm run test:rstation && PRODUCT_ROOT=$PWD/rstation/product PRODUCT=rstation rstation/platform/image-builder/build.sh --virt
